== Ingredients ==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (20–28 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) 1 inch-thick [[Cookbook:Beef#Loin|tenderloin]] steaks
* [[Cookbook:Montreal Steak Seasoning|Montreal Steak Seasoning]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* ⅔ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] untreated mesquite chips, soaked in water 30 minutes

== Procedure ==
#Heat about 30 charcoal briquets in a large chimney starter. Once hot, disperse evenly around the bottom of the [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] and toss in wood chips.
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] steaks with olive oil. Season both sides liberally with seasoning. Place on hottest part of grill and cook ½ minute. Rotate 90 degrees, and cook for another ½ minute. Flip and repeat 1 more time.
#Move steaks to a cooler part of grill and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 145°F for medium rare.
#Remove to a plate and let rest 5 minutes. Serve warm.

Brush steaks with olive oil. Season both sides liberally with seasoning. Place on hottest part of grill and cook ½ minute. Rotate 90 degrees, and cook for another ½ minute. Flip and repeat 1 more time.
